_doc: Deliberate changes of Pearl's own words (b2tools/gen4_text.py bank() applies them to every user of Pearl's text: the story generator, patches). Keyed by Pearl bank and line; each pair is [old, new] in pokediamond's .gmm spelling, and the old words must be in the line. Keep this short: Pearl's text is used word for word otherwise.
